overall_reason: Visitor mode inferred as Persuade: Stripe's figures are its own and mostly carry a window ('US$1.9tn in payments volume processed in 2025', '99.999% historical uptime'), its case studies and quotes name the customer and person, and the sweep's default_names hit on 'Zenith' sits in a product graphic beside example.com addresses, which I judge to be sample data (C22); only the hero GDP ticker claims more precision than any estimate can have.

score.reason: T-PROOF-SOURCE and T-PROOF-SWAP pass on named case studies and quotes; T-FIGURE-AUDIT and T-STAGED-UI fail once on the scripted eight-decimal GDP counter (INT-011).

findings.evidence: The first line on the page reads 'Global GDP running on Stripe: 1.74684173%'. The value changes between captures of the same page: 1.74648327% in the 1440 screenshot, 1.74684131% in the 375 DOM and 1.74684283% during the form test. The page shows no method, date or source for it.
findings.after: State the estimate at the precision its data supports, with its method and as-of date (for example 'about 1.7% of global GDP, 2025'), linked to the method
findings.why: Eight decimal places and a ticking value make an estimate look like a live measurement.

strengths: The stat band gives each figure its window or scope: '135+ currencies and payment methods supported', 'US$1.9tn in payments volume processed in 2025', '99.999% historical uptime', '200m+ active subscriptions managed on Stripe Billing'.
The case studies name the customer and end in 'Read the story' (Hertz, URBN, Instacart, Le Monde).
The quotes give a full name and role (Kurtis Moyer, Lead Product Manager of Payments, Mindbody; Peter Fitzpatrick, Vice President of Commerce, Thinkific; Dax Dasilva, Founder and CEO, Lightspeed).
The product graphics use example.com addresses and invented shops (Zenith Zen, Daybreak Yoga), the honest convention for sample data.
not_investigated: '50% of Fortune 100 companies' and '88% of the Forbes AI 50' cannot be checked from the page.
The 14-logo wall is unlinked; these are the brand's own customers, not verified externally.
Capture context: 43 requests were blocked, 18 of them images, so those images are not verified.
Async: the 'Continue' action was not found after reload, so the async check is not verified; the form test made 13 requests and showed only the ticker's new value.
T-PRICE-WHOLE: the prices on the page sit inside product graphics (checkout and billing demos), not an offer to the visitor; the pricing page was not captured.
T-URGENCY-REAL and T-DEFAULT-STATE skipped: no urgency and no choice control on the page itself.
authenticity against outside sources: the lens does not browse, so star counts, customer names and quoted studies are not verified beyond what the page shows
checkout, sign-up and cancellation flows beyond the captured page
countdown or counter behaviour on reload: the capture does not reload to compare
